items.title: Insulin Sensitivity Index May Aid CVD Risk Assessment
items.summary: Researchers say the test could eventually be integrated into electronic health records to help clinicians identify higher-risk patients and guide preventive care. Medscape Medical News

items.title: Review Questions Cancer Society’s Early PSA Guidance
items.summary: Spacing out screening intervals may be the key to reducing risks for unnecessary testing, treatment, and anxiety from detecting clinically insignificant prostate cancer. Medscape Medical News

items.title: Q&A: Catching ICI-Induced Kidney Damage Early
items.summary: The signs of immune-related kidney injury in patients on immune checkpoint inhibitors can be subtle, but prompt recognition is key to preventing potentially irreversible damage. Medscape Medical News

items.title: Like T1D, LADA Takes a Toll on Mental Health
items.summary: Both diseases are associated with depression, diabetes distress, and stigma. Medscape News Canada

items.title: The Mental Toll of Being Constantly Evaluated in Med School
items.summary: When med students are evaluated by nurses, preceptors, attendings, peer competitors, and everyone else, it does take a mental toll. Medscape Medical News

items.title: 5 Ways to Keep Your Practice Operational During IT Outages
items.summary: When systems fail, clinicians may lose access to records, medication lists, and e-prescribing. Clear downtime procedures can help teams maintain safe, continuous patient care. Medscape News Europe
